test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Quail
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Cringe'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that means the same as the given word **"Quail"** is **"Cringe".**
 
• In this context,** "Quail"** is a verb **meaning **to show fear or apprehension, or to shrink back in fear.(घबरा जाना, डर जाना)
 
• Similarly,** "Cringe" **means to shrink, bend, or crouch, especially in fear or servility; to behave in a servile or timid way.(झुकना, डरकर समाहित होना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Cringe'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's look at the meanings of the other words:
 
 
• **Approach:** This can mean to come near or nearer to (someone or something) in distance or time. (नजदीक आना, आगे बढ़ना)
 
• **Assail:** This means to attack someone physically or verbally.(हमला करना, आक्रमण करना)
 
• **Tyrant:** A tyrant is a ruler who uses power oppressively or unjustly.(अत्याचारी, निरंकुश शासक)
